title: ocai.signature_buffer
description: The verbatim concatenation of a reasoning part's streamed signature fragments (Anthropic signature_delta, Gemini thoughtSignature), preserved by StreamAccumulator when a part seals without a codec-minted `signature` ProviderRef. Only the dialect codec's transducer has the (provider, interface) context to mint the ref; the fold's job is to keep the fragments recoverable — reported EXTENSIONS, never dropped. Subsumed (not emitted) when the authoritative final part carries `signature`. Emitted by the fold itself (ocai/chat/types/stream.py), never by a provider codec.
x-ocai-promotion: none expected — the durable home is PartReasoning.signature, which the codec transducer mints
